scope: 34 Route I S/idle source faces and both forearms. This is source-region placement/extent review, not mask coverage, recolor quality, portrait acceptance, or owner approval.

criteria.PASS: The intended anatomical region is correctly located and no clear omitted anatomical extent was found at this pixel scale. Modest outline/transparency margins are retained.
criteria.FAIL: A clearly visible portion is omitted from the intended anatomical bounding rectangle, or the rectangle is materially displaced into cloth/gap/background. Face localization may still PASS while complete face extent FAILS.
criteria.UNCERTAIN: The visible segment is anatomical, but cloth occlusion or low-resolution joint landmarks prevent claiming the full elbow-to-wrist extent. A conservative visible-segment proposal may be given without removing the uncertainty.

independence.additional_inspection: Source PNGs were read directly and magnified with nearest-neighbor sampling in memory. No images or source assets were written. RGB values were read only to resolve source-coordinate ambiguity.
independence.source_annotation_creation_provenance: The annotation file states source-only construction. This reviewer independently checked semantics from source pixels, but did not witness the initial annotation process and does not certify its historical provenance.

limitations: The source sprites are very small; elbow and wrist landmarks are approximate even after nearest-neighbor magnification.
Cloak-occluded elbows remain uncertain after a conservative visible-arm expansion; no hidden anatomy is inferred as verified.
No mask coverage values or thresholds were consulted. Proposed boxes must be measured literally after integration.
This report reviews the captured original annotation hash. Proposed corrections are recommendations and have not been visually re-reviewed as an integrated second annotation set.
